prayers.title: Sign of the Cross
prayers.description: The Sign of the Cross is the most fundamental Catholic prayer and gesture, invoking the Trinity

prayers.title: Our Father
prayers.description: The Lord's Prayer, taught by Jesus to his disciples

prayers.title: Hail Mary
prayers.description: The Hail Mary combines the greeting of the Archangel Gabriel to Mary at the Annunciation with Elizabeth's greeting at the Visitation, followed by a prayer for Mary's intercession

prayers.title: Glory Be
prayers.description: The Glory Be (Gloria Patri) is a doxology, a short hymn of praise to the Trinity

prayers.title: Apostles' Creed
prayers.description: The Apostles' Creed is a summary of the apostles' teachings and one of the oldest and most widely used statements of Christian faith

prayers.title: Nicene Creed
prayers.description: The Nicene Creed is the most widely accepted statement of faith among Christian churches

prayers.title: Act of Contrition
prayers.description: The Act of Contrition is a prayer expressing sorrow for sin and is commonly recited during the Sacrament of Reconciliation (Confession)

prayers.title: Guardian Angel Prayer
prayers.description: A simple prayer taught to children to invoke the protection and guidance of their guardian angel

prayers.title: Act of Faith, Hope, and Charity
prayers.description: These three acts correspond to the theological virtues of faith, hope, and charity (love)

prayers.title: Eternal Rest (Prayer for the Dead)
prayers.description: This prayer is offered for the souls of the deceased, asking God to grant them eternal rest and the light of His presence

prayers.title: Morning Offering
prayers.description: The Morning Offering is a prayer said at the beginning of the day to dedicate all thoughts, words, and actions to God

prayers.title: Morning Thanksgiving Prayer
prayers.description: A prayer of gratitude for safe rest and the gift of a new day

prayers.title: Morning Offering Through Mary
prayers.description: Offering the day through the Immaculate Heart of Mary

prayers.title: Simple Morning Offering
prayers.description: A simple, child-friendly morning offering

prayers.title: Grace Before Meals
prayers.description: A traditional prayer said before meals to thank God for His provision and to ask His blessing on the food and those who will eat it

prayers.title: Grace After Meals
prayers.description: This prayer of thanksgiving is said after meals to thank God for His providence and care

prayers.title: Evening Thanksgiving Prayer
prayers.description: Formal evening prayer with thanksgiving, forgiveness, and intercession

prayers.title: Evening Prayer for Protection
prayers.description: Prayer asking for God's protection during the night hours

prayers.title: Prayer Before Sleep
prayers.description: A simple evening prayer entrusting oneself to God's care during sleep

prayers.title: Children's Bedtime Prayer (Four Angels)
prayers.description: Traditional children's prayer asking for angelic protection during sleep

prayers.title: Bedtime Examination of Conscience
prayers.description: Bedtime prayer combining examination of conscience with thanksgiving

prayers.title: Be Near Me Lord Jesus (Bedtime Prayer)
prayers.description: Beloved bedtime prayer from the Christmas carol 'Away in a Manger'

prayers.title: Compline Commendation (Into Your Hands)
prayers.description: Traditional responsory from Compline echoing Christ's final words

prayers.title: Compline Prayer for Protection
prayers.description: Compline antiphon asking for protection during waking and sleeping

prayers.title: Nunc Dimittis (Song of Simeon)
prayers.description: The canticle of Simeon when he held the infant Jesus in the Temple

prayers.title: Final Compline Prayer
prayers.description: The final prayer of Compline, balancing vigilance with peaceful rest

prayers.title: Gloria in Excelsis Deo
prayers.description: The Gloria is sung or recited during Mass on Sundays (except during Advent and Lent) and on solemnities and feasts

prayers.title: Sanctus (Holy, Holy, Holy)
prayers.description: The Sanctus is sung or recited during every Mass just before the Eucharistic Prayer

prayers.title: Memorial Acclamation A
prayers.description: We proclaim your Death, O Lord, and profess your Resurrection

prayers.title: Memorial Acclamation B
prayers.description: When we eat this Bread and drink this Cup

prayers.title: Memorial Acclamation C
prayers.description: Save us, Savior of the world

prayers.title: Lamb of God (Agnus Dei)
prayers.description: The Agnus Dei is sung or recited during the breaking of the bread at Mass, just before Communion

prayers.title: Prayer Before Mass
prayers.description: This prayer helps prepare the soul for the celebration of Mass and reception of Holy Communion

prayers.title: Anima Christi (Soul of Christ)
prayers.description: The beloved prayer asking for intimate union with Jesus after Communion

prayers.title: Suscipe Prayer (Take and Receive)
prayers.description: St. Ignatius' prayer of complete surrender to God's will

prayers.title: Memorare
prayers.description: The Memorare is a powerful prayer seeking the intercession of the Blessed Virgin Mary

prayers.title: Angelus
prayers.description: The Angelus is a devotional prayer commemorating the Incarnation

prayers.title: Regina Caeli
prayers.description: The Regina Caeli (Queen of Heaven) is a Marian antiphon traditionally recited or sung during the Easter season (from Easter Sunday through Pentecost)

prayers.title: Hail Holy Queen (Salve Regina)
prayers.description: The Salve Regina is one of the most beloved Marian antiphons, traditionally sung at the end of Compline (Night Prayer)

prayers.title: Alma Redemptoris Mater (Loving Mother of the Redeemer)
prayers.description: The Alma Redemptoris Mater is a Marian antiphon traditionally sung at Compline from Advent through Candlemas (February 2)

prayers.title: Ave Regina Caelorum (Hail Queen of Heaven)
prayers.description: The Ave Regina Caelorum is a Marian antiphon traditionally sung at Compline from Candlemas through Holy Wednesday (Lent)

prayers.title: Sub Tuum Praesidium (We Fly to Your Protection)
prayers.description: Sub Tuum Praesidium is believed to be the oldest known Marian prayer, with papyrus fragments dating to around 250-280 AD found in Egypt

prayers.title: Prayer to the Immaculate Heart of Mary
prayers.description: Devotion to the Immaculate Heart of Mary is closely linked with the Sacred Heart of Jesus

prayers.title: Prayer to St. Michael
prayers.description: The Prayer to St. Michael the Archangel is a powerful prayer for protection against evil

prayers.title: Prayer to St. Joseph
prayers.description: St. Joseph is the patron saint of the universal Church, workers, fathers, and the dying

prayers.title: Prayer of St. Francis (Peace Prayer)
prayers.description: The famous Peace Prayer capturing St. Francis' spirit of peace and service

prayers.title: Prayer of St. Francis Before the Crucifix
prayers.description: St. Francis' authentic prayer before the crucifix of San Damiano

prayers.title: Prayer to St. Anthony for Lost Things
prayers.description: Traditional prayer asking St. Anthony's help in finding lost things

prayers.title: Powerful Prayer to St. Anthony
prayers.description: Prayer emphasizing St. Anthony's miraculous powers and relationship with the Infant Jesus

prayers.title: Prayer to St. Thérèse (The Little Flower)
prayers.description: Traditional prayer to the Little Flower asking for roses and favors

prayers.title: St. Thérèse's Morning Offering
prayers.description: St. Thérèse's own morning offering prayer from her writings

prayers.title: Prayer to St. Rita of Cascia
prayers.description: St. Rita of Cascia is known as the 'Saint of the Impossible' and patron of desperate, hopeless, and impossible causes

prayers.title: Novena Prayer to St. Jude
prayers.description: Traditional novena prayer to St. Jude for hopeless causes

prayers.title: St. Jude, Glorious Apostle
prayers.description: Prayer acknowledging St. Jude's special privilege to help in desperate situations

prayers.title: St. Teresa's Bookmark Prayer
prayers.description: St. Teresa's famous prayer of abandonment to God's will

prayers.title: Christ Has No Body (Teresa of Avila Inspired)
prayers.description: Prayer emphasizing our role as Christ's hands, feet, and eyes in the world

prayers.title: Prayer for St. Teresa's Intercession
prayers.description: Prayer asking for St. Teresa's intercession to grow in divine love

prayers.title: Prayer to the Sacred Heart of Jesus
prayers.description: Devotion to the Sacred Heart of Jesus emphasizes God's boundless and passionate love for humanity

prayers.title: Veni Creator Spiritus (Come, Creator Spirit)
prayers.description: The Veni Creator Spiritus is one of the most ancient and revered hymns to the Holy Spirit

prayers.title: Formal Prayer for the Pope
prayers.description: Formal liturgical prayer for the Pope from the Roman Missal

prayers.title: Biblical Blessing for the Pope
prayers.description: Prayer combining biblical blessings for the Pope's protection and peace

prayers.title: Adoro Te Devote
prayers.description: A profound Eucharistic hymn by St. Thomas Aquinas meditating on the Real Presence of Christ in the Blessed Sacrament

prayers.title: St. Patrick's Breastplate
prayers.description: A powerful prayer of protection by St. Patrick invoking the Trinity and Christ's presence in all circumstances

prayers.title: Prayer of Abandonment
prayers.description: A powerful prayer of complete surrender and trust in God's will by Blessed Charles de Foucauld

prayers.title: Prayer of St. Ephrem the Syrian
prayers.description: A powerful Lenten prayer by St. Ephrem the Syrian seeking freedom from vice and growth in virtue

prayers.title: Prayer of St. Gertrude for the Holy Souls
prayers.description: A powerful prayer by St. Gertrude the Great offering Christ's Precious Blood for the souls in Purgatory and sinners

prayers.title: Litany of the Sacred Heart of Jesus
prayers.description: A litany invoking the Sacred Heart of Jesus with over 33 invocations celebrating His divine attributes

prayers.title: Litany of Loreto (Litany of the Blessed Virgin Mary)
prayers.description: The most beloved Marian litany invoking Our Lady under her many titles and virtues

prayers.title: Litany of St. Joseph
prayers.description: A litany honoring St. Joseph, the foster father of Jesus and spouse of Mary, invoking his protection and intercession

prayers.title: Litany of the Holy Spirit
prayers.description: A litany invoking the Holy Spirit under His many titles, gifts, and fruits

prayers.title: Kyrie Eleison (Lord, Have Mercy)
prayers.description: The Kyrie is the ancient penitential acclamation invoking God's mercy, sung or recited at the beginning of Mass

prayers.title: Asperges Me (Sprinkle Me, O Lord)
prayers.description: The Asperges Me is sung during the sprinkling of holy water on Sundays outside the Easter season

prayers.title: Vidi Aquam (I Saw Water)
prayers.description: The Vidi Aquam is sung during the sprinkling of holy water in the Easter season

prayers.title: Benedicite (Canticle of the Three Children)
prayers.description: The Benedicite is a canticle from Daniel calling all creation to bless the Lord

prayers.title: Divine Praises
prayers.description: The Divine Praises are recited after Benediction of the Blessed Sacrament to make reparation for blasphemy

prayers.title: Daily Examen (Ignatian)
prayers.description: St. Ignatius' method of daily prayerful reflection to discern God's presence in our lives

prayers.title: Prayer Before Confession
prayers.description: A prayer asking the Holy Spirit for enlightenment and true contrition before Confession

prayers.title: Prayer After Confession
prayers.description: A prayer of thanksgiving after receiving absolution in the Sacrament of Reconciliation

prayers.title: Prayer Before Communion
prayers.description: A prayer of preparation for receiving Holy Communion

prayers.title: Prayer After Communion
prayers.description: A prayer of thanksgiving after receiving Holy Communion

prayers.title: Prayer to Our Lady of Guadalupe
prayers.description: A prayer asking for the intercession of Our Lady of Guadalupe, Patroness of the Americas

prayers.title: O Antiphons (The Great Antiphons)
prayers.description: The seven Great O Antiphons, sung at Vespers during the final days of Advent (December 17-23), invoking Christ under His Messianic titles

prayers.title: Christmas Proclamation (The Proclamation of the Birth of Christ)
prayers.description: The solemn proclamation of the birth of Christ from the Roman Martyrology, traditionally proclaimed at Christmas Midnight Mass

prayers.title: Veni Sancte Spiritus (Come, Holy Spirit)
prayers.description: The Golden Sequence for Pentecost Sunday, a poetic hymn invoking the Holy Spirit with sevenfold gifts
